ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText throws NotAllowedError in some environments (Playwright/embedded iframes/HTTP) and is not wrapped in try/catch — surfaces a full-page red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay in dev. Should fall back to document.execCommand or silently catch.

Clicking period-monthly/period-quarterly/period-annual does not change the value rendered inside stat-mtd card (label stays 'THIS MONTH/MTD/$0.00' for all 3 periods). If the toggle is intended only to redraw the chart, that is fine; otherwise stat-mtd should reflect QTD/YTD when toggled. With $0 for new user this could not be fully validated.

action_items: Wrap navigator.clipboard.writeText in try/catch on copy-link (and copy-code) to prevent runtime error overlay when clipboard API is unavailable; also add a fallback (document.execCommand('copy') on a hidden input).
Confirm whether period toggle is supposed to update the stat-mtd card text; if yes, wire it. If toggle is chart-only, consider renaming testid expectation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1778 lines — recommend modular split (routers/payments.py, routers/affiliate.py, routers/auth_reset.py).

/payments/status/{sid} auto-finalizes mocked sessions on first poll, which doubles as a side-effect endpoint — fine for mock but document clearly so production Stripe flow (STRIPE_MODE!=mock) isn't accidentally hit by status polling.
Password reset endpoint correctly returns ok+no dev_reset_link for unknown email (no enumeration leak). Token reuse is rejected with 400. Good.
CEO endpoints properly excluded mongodb _id from responses (verified).
